supersedes: The earlier video03_evidence.json left every flight count unknown. This follow-up resolves ONLY the upper flight observed from the initial full-floor landing at 1.4-2.5 seconds.

bounded_flight.scope_zh: 影片起始整層平台上方、在1.4–2.5秒鏡頭向右轉時看見的上行跑；不是拍攝者隨後走下的第一跑。
bounded_flight.direction_zh: 從起始整層平台面向內側半層平台，這是中央梯井左邊的上行跑。
bounded_flight.riser_definition: One vertical level rise; the last rise terminates at the half-landing surface. This is not a claim of 11 separate treads plus a further landing riser.
bounded_flight.lower_endpoint_zh: 最下白色立面與大方地磚整層平台相接，地面及首級均在畫面內。
bounded_flight.upper_endpoint_zh: 第11白色立面之後接水平半層平台；深色牆腳踢腳亦在該處轉為水平。沒有把後方扶手或陰影另算成梯級。
bounded_flight.continuity_zh: 1.733–2.000秒拍攝者在整層平台上向右轉視角，沒有沿這跑上樓。首級、末級持續可見；人物主要遮擋右半邊，左半邊可逐級讀取。
bounded_flight.annotation_note: Filename retains candidate from peer-review preparation. Annotation numbers are evidence labels, not fabricated geometry. Original lossless frame is preserved alongside it.
bounded_flight.crop_note: Simple crop and 2x resize for readability only, no generated detail or super-resolution.

other_flights.reason: Do not extend a count from this one clearly bounded upper flight to other flights, storeys or buildings.

observed_relative_sequence.count_limit: Near-camera top nosing sits at/crosses lower image edge; people also occlude other edges. Whole flight is not approved as 11.
Turn and start of descent do not supply a reliably bounded full-flight count; person and suitcase occlude stair edges.
Several stair edges visible, but no independently verified simultaneous first/last endpoint count.
Top endpoint moves out of view during turn; suitcase/person cover lower edges at earlier times. No exact full-flight count approved.

other_flights.continuity_zh: 可確認連續路線次序為兩對折返梯段、三個整層平台及兩個內側半層平台。這是相對高差與連接關係，並非已定位的2/3/4樓。四個下行跑各自完整級數均保留未知。
other_flights.comparison_with_verified_flight: The verified 11-riser upper flight is A -> A+0.5, whereas the filmed descent begins A -> A-0.5. They are different flights.

proportions.reason_zh: 牆磚／踏磚有透視及局部遮擋，且兩種磚不一定同尺寸。沒有量測標尺，不能把任意小方磚規格當實際尺度。只可保存11個上升面的拓撲事實；尺度需由已校準的建築／樓層高度另行定義並標明來源。

tile_grid_inspection.tread_rows: approximately 4 visible tile rows plus nosing strip
tile_grid_inspection.limits_zh: 清晰近照的兩側完整梯寬未同時顯示，不能核定整跑橫向磚列。行數只是局部外觀估讀，不支持毫米尺寸或對整校的尺度宣稱。

independent_review: Parent independently counted the same eleven riser faces on the 1.900-second frame.
scene_edit_approval: none; only evidence and reference annotations were produced
location_limit_zh: 這份計數不自行認定地理方位或樓層。若其他證據對到教學樓左端，可將影片的這一可見跑作局部參考；仍不能生成未拍到的六層。
